task_title: Full-File Audio Integrity & Complete Stream-Termination Validation

issue_a_speaker_completeness.description: Initialize completeness inventory from all 1,265 provisional manifest speakers, ensuring zero-clip state reports 1,265 incomplete speakers.
issue_a_speaker_completeness.accounting_rule: Every speaker in provisional manifest initialized in speaker_completeness with required_clips_count=15.

issue_b_genuine_mp3_validation.description: Strict MP3 container validation, full-file bounded-memory chunk decoding, late truncation detection, and explicit sample-rate contract.
issue_b_genuine_mp3_validation.full_stream_chunk_decoding: sf.SoundFile(str(path)).read(4096) decodes entire file in bounded-memory chunks without loading full audio into memory
issue_b_genuine_mp3_validation.frame_completeness_check: total_decoded_frames >= declared_frames strictly enforced; detects and rejects truncation or corruption occurring after the first 1,000 frames

issue_c_streaming_resume_verification.description: Full Content-Range structure parsing (start/end/total), total consistency tracking across reconnects, initial 206 zero-offset validation, gzip EOF termination integrity check, and premature 416 rejection.

http_resume_contract.content_range_structure: bytes {start}-{end}/{total} parsed; validates start >= 0, end >= start, total > end (when total != '*')
http_resume_contract.total_consistency_tracking: Resource total length must remain identical across all reconnections
http_resume_contract.initial_connection_validation: Initial request (no Range) expects 200 OK; if 206 received, start must be 0
http_resume_contract.gzip_termination_integrity: readinto() enforces decompressor.eof == True before returning EOF (0 bytes); rejects truncated streams
http_resume_contract.premature_http_416_rejection: Rejects HTTP 416 received before total bytes or archive completion
